September has been a weak month as expected.  
"Nine of eleven sectors are lower month-to-date. Only Energy and Communication Services, 14% of the index between them, are higher. This has been a meaningful drawdown under the surface, but importantly, it has remained rotational rather than disorderly." - Citadel Securities
